sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States: Outer Mongolia memorandum,19July1945
sources.note: Original diplomatic memorandum read.1911 regime,1912 Russian backing,1915 tripartite agreement recognized autonomy while retaining Chinese claim. Historical US diplomatic account, not modern territorial endorsement.

sources.title: Library of Congress, Mongolia: A Country Study, historical chronology
sources.note: Original indexed LOC chronology checked:11July1921 People’s Government limited monarchy. Direct extraction exceeds web29.6MB limit. Only this narrow chronological fact drawn from the work.

sources.title: US Department of State: Background Notes, Mongolia (April1998)
sources.note: Original indexed full historical section read.1919 Chinese troops,1921 Soviet victory/Urga,1930s religious purges and1939 Soviet-Mongolian victory. Direct archive intermittently returns technical error. Its November25,1924 proclamation date rejected in favor of Mongolian museum November26. Older interpretive language about Chinese province not adopted.

sources.title: Mongolian Natural History Museum: anniversary of the first constitution
sources.note: Original museum institutional commemoration indexed directly:26November1924 republic and first constitution,2025 anniversary. Does not use official rhetoric to imply socialist electoral democracy.

sources.title: National Museum of Mongolia: permanent exhibitions, halls8 and9
sources.note: Original complete indexed museum text read. Hall8:1945 silver-adorned wooden pail awarded for herding over1000 animals,20October1945 referendum voting sheet. Hall9:1989-1990 demonstrations,hunger strike,election,1992 constitution and difficult market transition. Direct page fails; exact indexed query site.en.nationalmuseum.mn/permanent "March" "1990" "January" resolves chronology.

sources.title: Government of Mongolia and UNDP, Human Development Report Mongolia2003
sources.note: Original report indexed text checked, Human development before1990 section: life expectancy46.7in1960 to63.7in1990,adultliteracy97.8%,education/health access and restrictions on freedoms. Direct UNESCO mirror challenge; original PDF indexed query title returned relevant paragraphs. No claim universal quality or causal proof from two figures alone.

sources.title: Parliament of Mongolia: Mongolian Constitution, adopted13January1992
sources.note: Official original-script heading at lines127-129: Монгол Улсын Үндсэн хууль,dated1992-01-13. Modern digital title is witness, not photographed1992 autograph. Translation independently confirmed by official English Constitutional Court edition. Combined as one work.

sources.title: Constitutional Court of Mongolia: Constitution, English text
sources.note: Official English title,Articles1/8/70 directly read. Title gloss Constitution of Mongolia; Article1 independentsovereignrepublic; Article70 entryinto force12February1992. Translation includes old provisions elsewhere, not treated as fully amendedcurrenttext. Same work budget with mgl-constitution.

sources.title: OSCE ODIHR: final report conclusions on Mongolia’s2024 parliamentary elections
sources.note: Original16December2024 observer announcement directly read. Professional administration but unequal campaign/media environment. Dated assessment, not current party result/officeholders.

sources.title: United Nations in Mongolia:60th anniversary of UN accession (2021)
sources.note: Original UN commemorative speech read,27October1961 accession,101stmember. Uses only precise admission fact and diplomatic significance; celebratory unqualified democracy claims omitted.

sources.title: UNESCO, traditional craftsmanship of the Mongol Ger and associated customs,2013 decision
sources.note: Original UNESCO2013 decision full text read:felt/canvas/wood/ropes,portable frame,household collaboration,elder mentoring and children observing assembly. One work across language/listing versions.

sources.title: UNESCO, traditional technique of making Airag in Khokhuur,2019 listing
sources.note: Original listing read: mare milk,cowhide vessel,wooden paddle,over500 churns,starter,celebrations/parent teaching. Source’s medicinal-efficacy assertion omitted. No suggestion children consume alcohol.

sources.title: UNICEF Mongolia: first two Bagh schools open,16November2025
sources.note: Original report read:UenchKhovd andBorshooUvs,75children each;36000leavehome forschool everySeptember. Outcome is opening two facilities, not nationalproblem solved.

sources.title: UNICEF, Bathrooms On The Move,27July2015
sources.note: Original report directly read, lines22-32. Relocatable insulated WASH House,lit/heated,waterbasins,septic/wellconnections,15installed1400studentsasof2015. Teacher-reportedhealth effects omitted as not causaltrial.

sources.title: WHO, integrating mobile health care in hard-to-reach communities,22June2022
sources.note: Original full text directly/indexed read. Mobile/homevisits forherders/miners,22PHCcentres2016to302in2021,diagnosis/maternalchildservices. Uses no live2026coverage claim or individual advice.

sources.title: UNDP: Mongolia launches assessments of2023-2024 dzud,28May2025
sources.note: Original institutional report read,2024loss over7.44million livestock,household effects and assessment. Final retrospective total, not earlier fluctuating snapshot.

sources.title: American Museum of Natural History: Dinosaur Eggs
sources.note: Original museum research account read:1923 FlamingCliffs,initialProtoceratopsattribution,1990s Oviraptor-like embryo revision. No copied fieldnotes, no claim first eggs worldwide or that dinosaurs lived with people.

proposedOverrides.name: Mongolia (modern state)
proposedOverrides.summary: Modern Mongolia across contested independence, revolutionary and socialist rule, democratic transition and continuing cultural and social change; the atlas begins in 1914.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: New distinct modern-state card; no alias sharing.
batchIdentityNotes.boundaries: Separate existing mongols1100-1200 and mongol-empire1206-1294. Modern country is not all ethnic Mongol territories,InnerMongolia,or a single pastoral culture.1914mapstart is not1911declaration or1924republic founding. The1914-1920slice crosses1915autonomyagreement and1919abolition;1920-1930crosses1921revolution and1924republic.
batchIdentityNotes.freshness: Checked23September2026. Currentpoliticsdiscussed via specificallydated2024electionreport, notunverifiedofficeholders;2025schoolopening/assessment explicitly dated. No unsupportedendyear.
